calculation.description: Ranks assets higher when their recent daily return signs are inconsistent with persistent directional behavior, after scaling directional persistence by 60-session volatility. The one-session lag ensures only completed data are used. The leading negative sign is selected because the directly tested consistency signal had negative forward IC.

validation.regime_notes: The inverted factor was positive in every reported regime at the 20-day horizon: 2024-2026 IC 0.132219 (106 dates), 2027-2029 IC 0.132845 (782 dates), 2030 IC 0.111403 (261 dates), and 2031-01-01 through 2032-01-21 IC 0.099208 (256 dates). Cross-sectional observations required at least 8 of the 15 tradable instruments.
validation.artifact_note: The artifact contains the un-inverted diagnostic consistency signal; recoverable production signal is its negative as specified in calculation.expression.
